basic_info.main_problem: I am very unproductive in all areas of life outside of work, which leads to my lacking motivation and a sense of self-worth; the problem already affects maintaining relationships and self-care, and has become more pronounced in recent months.
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为我意识到个人领域的动力与生产力not足正在影响我的整体幸福与健康。
growth_experiences: For a long time, in personal life domains outside work, feeling a lack of productivity and motivation (describing oneself as 'it has been like this since I can remember', markedly worsening in recent months), more obvious when comparing with others, causing difficulty maintaining relationships and self-care.
在High work pressure的时期，曾反复出现低动力与低自我价值感的经历；尽管工作表现尚可，但个人生活的任务更难以推进。
社会与家庭支持薄弱：Living alone，与家人联系有限，整体社交支持系统较弱，难以与他人讨论个人困扰。

core_beliefs: 我缺乏个人自律与工作伦理
I am not as good as others那样有生产力

special_situations.event: Comparing with those others whose 'lives are in perfect order'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not像他们一样有条理且高效，就说明我懒惰或失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing attempts and avoiding personal tasks to avoid being proven a failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others，我很懒

special_situations.event: Facing personal tasks lacking external structure (such as self-care, diet plans, relationship maintenance)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: have not清晰的外部结构我就做not好，最后一定会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 拖延与回避，直到not得not做才去处理

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能一直完成计划，就证明我本质上懒惰且not救
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 一次失败后停止尝试，ReinforcementSelf-denial与消极标签

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 感到压力说明我能力not足，证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在个人生活中进一步减少行动与社交，以降低Anxiety

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as a capable and self-disciplined person, to have structure and achievement in personal life as in work, and to maintain stable relationships and a sense of self-worth
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被比较后显得not如人、被评价为懒惰与have not价值；害怕尝试后失败加剧羞耻感
defense_goal: 通过回避个人任务与自我苛责来降低失败与羞耻的Anxiety；停留在工作这一结构化环境以维持最低限度的自我价值感

object_relations.self_representation: not够自律、容易失败的自我
object_relations.object_representation: Others are organized, efficient judges/standard holders

object_relations.self_representation: 孤立且缺乏支持的个体
object_relations.object_representation: Others/family are distant objects from whom support is hard to obtain

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When comparing herself with others or being asked about personal life arrangements and progress
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将比较解读为自己“本质懒惰、have not价值”，把个人领域的not足归结为稳定的人格缺陷
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气低落、倾向自责，use“我not行/我很懒”等标签化语言，放大缺点、淡化长处，并回避进一步探讨具体可行的改变路径。

manifestations: Long-term feeling that personal life lacks motivation and direction, equating self-worth with productivity
Hard to start and persist with tasks in personal domains
Little social interaction, hard to discuss personal troubles
在缺乏外部结构的个人生活中感到without序与失控
难以自我安排与自我约束
outcomes: 个人生活任务推进困难

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently labels self as 'lazy' and 'lacking self-discipline'
在与他人比较后过度Self-denial，降低行动意愿

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'strong personal work ethic and high self-discipline' as an absolute standard that must be reached
若达not到即认定自己是失败者

positive_force: In a structured environment (work), can stably complete tasks, with transferable execution and persistence abilities
Positive attitude; willing to try new methods (such as behavioral experiments)
具备自我Reflection与清晰表达的能力
negative_force: Attributes problems to stable personality defects ('laziness', 'lack of self-discipline')
缺乏社会支持，Living alone，与家人联系有限
When facing unstructured tasks, predicts failure and avoids action

target_behavior.behavior: 在个人生活中回避和拖延日常任务与自我照料（Insufficient motivation、启动困难）
antecedent: 与他人比较后感到自卑
Facing personal tasks lacking clear structure or goals
target_behavior.core_reason: 将生产力not足标签化为“懒惰”，并灾难化预测“I will fail/完成not了”，为避免羞耻与失败而Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与自我羞耻，短期降低Anxiety与压力感
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships维系受损，饮食与自我照料下降，整体幸福感与Lowered sense of self-worth
